name: Some Beaches "The Rock" Hand-Smashed Cheeseburger (Plain Bun Mod)
whyItWorks: 100% ground chuck smashburger on a soft artisan white bun with aged cheddar cheese; skipping raw onion rings and spicy hot honey keeps it easy on the gut after a day on Bear Lake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Rock Cheeseburger" plain with aged cheddar on the artisan bun (ketchup or mayo on the side)—skip the fried onion rings on the Spinnacker and the chili-infused Garden City Hot Honey.
watchOuts: Skip raw onions, fried onion rings, and spicy hot honey glaze
